# Design point P010

## Description

A centralized repository service would serve as the primary access point, persisting write-ahead logs on an S3 Express low-latency object-storage tier for high-throughput repository state durability. It would favor consistency and partition tolerance, acknowledging writes only when those guarantees can be maintained and refusing or delaying them when conflicts arise, reducing availability during partitions.
